items.title: Nile Rodgers Defends AI Use in Music Video: 'We Created Everything ... The AI Did What We Told It to Do'
items.excerpt: Nile Rodgers defended the AI-generated visuals in an upcoming Christmas charity music video after fan backlash, saying the team created everything and the AI only executed their direction.

items.title: Nile Rodgers Becomes the Latest Musician to Support AI

items.title: Apple Logic Pro 13 out now: redesigned DAW UI, new browser, and AI not for everyone
